name: Lilith
source:
The first wife of Adam, Lilith has spent the last few millennia sowing as much discord as she can among humans. Her task is to corrupt souls, and her unique approach to doing so is striking deals with young men, granting them the gift to corrupt for her or forfeit their own souls.

[from [url=https://demondeals.org/characters]official site[/url]]
